question: Which state in India has the highest percentage of the Hindu population in 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hinduism is the largest religion in India. According to the 2011 Census of India, 966.3 Million people identify as Hindu, representing **79.8%** of the country's population.
 
• In **Himachal Pradesh,** 95.17 % of the population belongs to the Hindu community.
 
• While **Mizoram **is with 2.75 %, the lowest percentage of the Hindu population in the state.
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** have 93.93 % of the Hindu community which is the highest among UTs and **Lakshwdeep **is with 2.77% which is the lowest among the UTs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first ever CENUS in India was conducted by **Lord Mayo**.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** has the **highest **population state according to Census 2011.
 
• **Sikkim **has the **Lowest **Population state according to Census 2011.
 
• **Kerala **has the **highest **Literacy state according to Census 2011.
 
• **Bihar **has the **Lowest **Literacy state according to Census 2011.
